# dsh-plugin-index
A tiny **DeepSeek Harness plugin-market index** (format 1) for the plugins maintained by Aily-DSH.
DSH's in-client plugin market does not search npm: it only reads the index URLs you configure. Point
`dsh.profile.indexes` at the jsDelivr URL below and the market page will list these plugins with th
eir install targets.
## Use it
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart DSH (or reload the profile) and open **设置 → 插件市场**.
## Plugins in this index
| Plugin | What it does |
| dsh-peak-guard | Warns before DeepSeek peak-priced hours, stops selected sessions, resumes them wh

en off-peak pricing starts. |
| dsh-sidebar-tab-close | Double-click a right-sidebar tab to close it

; Ctrl+W prefers the active sidebar tab over the window. |
| dsh-quick-chat | A row of quick-send ch

ips in the composer: one click sends a saved phrase, up to ten editable presets stored locally. |
|

dsh-test-window | Test windows always open on the display you pick in settings. |
| dsh-session-usag

e | Per-conversation token usage (input / cache read / cache write / output) and estimated cost. |
|

dsh-superagent-manager | Manage several super-agent projects from one DSH client. |
| dsh-approval-
inbox | Turns blocking approvals into a background queue: requests wait in a sidebar inbox while the
agent keeps working, approvals made in peak-priced hours run off-peak. |
## Format
`index.json` follows the format-1 contract of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index`: top-level `for
mat: 1`, localized `title` / `description`, declared `metadata.categories`, and a `plugins[]` array
where every version pins an exact git commit.
